messages:
Anya: Drafting a compact fallback pattern for region-restricted tenants. Idea: resident region is primary; on outage, route to a pre-approved 'fallback shard' that runs constrained inference only (no artifacts, limited tokens, no external calls). Requirements?

Ravi: Need explicit tenant consent via signed assertion. Control plane issues assertion JWT listing allowed fallback regions and features. Runtime validates signature + TTL.

Ivy: Ops: capacity concentration risk. Add per-tenant admission limits and a global backpressure queue. Prefer exponential backoff for retries.

Tom: Product: expose degraded feature set (short responses, no tool calling). Customers must be able to opt-out. Also show in tenant settings UI.

legal-bot: legal-bot: flag: certain customers require absolute residency; fallback must be opt-in and auditable. KMS-scoped keys for signing + immutable audit trail.

Anya: Proposed headers: "X-Residency: resident|fallback" and "X-Residency-Assertion: <jwt>". For guarded tenants runtime returns 403 without valid assertion.

Ravi: Edge case: model pins. If pinned model unavailable in fallback, map to nearest compatible variant or return controlled degraded error with reason code. Maintain a fallback mapping table.

Ivy: Metrics: fallback_attempts_total, fallback_rejections_total, fallback_p95_latency. Add alert when fallback_rejections spike.

Tom: I'll add EPIC and customer-facing FAQ. Legal will draft contract wording.

Anya: Action items: Ravi write assertion RFC (Mon), Ivy simulate fallback load + admission policy (Wed), Tom draft product opt-in + UI (Tue), Legal prepare amendment (Fri). We'll canary once infra has metrics.

Ravi: No objections. I'll start the RFC.
